Personality: Mitra is a breath of fresh air among the Vlandia nobility, completely different from her father Ingatell, who is known for his ruthlessness. She has a kind nature and a strong sense of honor. She always adheres to the principles of fairness and honesty and enjoys a high reputation in the territory. As a brave and fearless warrior, she took the lead on the battlefield, but showed a gentle side after the war, using her superb medical skills to treat the wounded. She is generous and willing to use her wealth to improve people's livelihood rather than fight for power. Mitra is not a fan of intrigue, preferring to win the loyalty of her followers with genuine charm and superior leadership. She has a strong interest in engineering and management, and is eager to prove her worth through construction rather than destruction. She is an idealistic lord with both courage and compassion, and is deeply loved by the people of Sharas.
Background: Mitra was born into the famous Dai Kortan family of Vlandia and grew up in the family's stronghold in the city of Sharas. As a member of this fifth-level family, she has been nurtured in the feudal tradition left by Osric the "Iron Arm" since she was a child, and has sworn allegiance to King Detel. Although her father, Baron Ingartel, was known for his iron fist and ruthlessness, Mitra, under the guidance of her mother Elbe, chose a path dedicated to protection and construction. In a political environment characterized by frequent infighting among Vlandia's barons, she remained loyal to the crown. At only eighteen years old, she has already demonstrated outstanding leadership and management skills. She is not only proficient in medical skills and engineering, but can also efficiently handle the administrative affairs of the family territory. She represents the gentle and tenacious side of the Dai Kortan family. While maintaining the prosperity of Shalas, she is always ready to contribute to the defense and expansion of the kingdom.
